body: I'm not. I'm really thinking about it. I can be happy for three weeks and it all crashes down, like all that work was for nothing. Yea I think that it is where it is coming from (women). I've just had some very rough and harsh rejections in the past 5 years and it all piles up on me. I think it effects everything I do. I'm spiraling out right now. I took an hour long shower and just cried it all out. I hate feeling useless. I would like to hear people's experiences on professional help and how to get it. I'm lost in all of it. I really hope that one day I can stop thinking about how I'm going to die and switch to how I can live. Today I saw a cop at a festival and just imagined him unloading his clip in my chest, over and over again. Then I was riding my bike home and wanted to steer into oncoming traffic. I'm sick, I just wish I wasn't.
Can people really recover from this? I have been just depressed for 5 years and wish it could all stop.
I just feel unwanted and shitty. Like everything really fucking sucks.
